playbook.name: Tasks Due Soon
playbook.description: Notifies the user of open Task-type sprk_event records (sprk_eventtype_ref = Task) due from their local today through today + 3 days on their matters, on matters they own, or that they own. The 3-day window is fixed (the scheduler sets dueSoonWindowUtc; the dueWithinDays parameter is not applied yet). Uses Spaarke custom sprk_event entity (NOT OOB task activity).

configJson.description: Scoped to the current user's matters (resolved via LookupUserMembership node)

Resolve the matters FOR the executing user via the people-targeting surface (targeting: people, ADR-034 Amendment A3): records they created (human Created By), are named on (Assigned To, via their linked contact) or personally own — never matters reached only through team, business-unit or organization ownership. Bound to `myMatters.ids` for downstream filtering (the query writes them as <value> children with fetchInGuids).

configJson.fetchXml: <fetch top="50"><entity name="sprk_event"><attribute name="sprk_eventname"/><attribute name="sprk_duedate"/><attribute name="sprk_finalduedate"/><attribute name="sprk_eventid"/><attribute name="sprk_eventtype_ref"/><attribute name="statuscode"/><attribute name="modifiedon"/><attribute name="sprk_regardingrecordname"/><attribute name="sprk_regardingrecordurl"/><attribute name="sprk_regardingmatter"/><attribute name="ownerid"/><link-entity name="sprk_matter" from="sprk_matterid" to="sprk_regardingmatter" link-type="outer" alias="m"><attribute name="sprk_mattername"/><attribute name="ownerid"/></link-entity><filter type="and"><condition attribute="sprk_eventtype_ref" operator="eq" value="124f5fc9-98ff-f011-8406-7c1e525abd8b"/><condition attribute="statuscode" operator="eq" value="659490001"/><filter type="and"><condition attribute="sprk_duedate" operator="ge" value="{{todayUtc}}"/><condition attribute="sprk_duedate" operator="le" value="{{dueSoonWindowUtc}}"/></filter><filter type="or"><condition attribute="sprk_regardingmatter" operator="in">{{fetchInGuids myMatters.ids}}</condition><condition entityname="m" attribute="ownerid" operator="eq-userid"/><condition attribute="ownerid" operator="eq-userid"/></filter></filter><order attribute="sprk_duedate" descending="false"/></entity></fetch>
configJson.description: Open Task-type sprk_event rows (sprk_eventtype_ref = Task 124f5fc9-98ff-f011-8406-7c1e525abd8b, statuscode = Open 659490001) with sprk_duedate from the user's local today (todayUtc, set per user by the scheduler) through today + 3 days (dueSoonWindowUtc, set by the scheduler), where (a) sprk_regardingmatter is one of the user's matters (myMatters.ids from Lookup My Matters, written as <value> children by fetchInGuids; an empty list matches nothing), OR (b) the linked matter's owner is the user, OR (c) the task's own owner is the user. sprk_finalduedate is read for display only (D-63). Ordered by sprk_duedate ascending (D-73); at most 50.
Check if any tasks are due within the configured window

configJson.title: {{dueSoonQuery.output.count}} task(s) due in the next {{dueWithinDays}} day(s)
